newsitem.title: UK: ICI continues decline on downgrades fallout.
newsitem.headline: ICI continues decline on downgrades fallout.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries dropped in a rising market on Friday, as investors continued to offload stock after a spate of recent earnings downgrades.
ICI shares were down 14p, or 1.7 percent, at 821-1/2p by 1111 GMT, while the broader market was up 0.34 percent. Some 711,000 shares had changed hands by that time.

"We think the shares could break below eight stg...there have been some severe downgrades and this is a continuation of that," one market maker said, adding that the recent oil price rise had not helped the company's position.
ICI shares have lost over seven percent since hitting a five-month high of 889p on October 2.
On Tuesday NatWest Securities lowered its profit estimates.

The shares came under more pressure on Wednesday when the Financial Times newspaper highlighted the recent string of cuts in analysts' profit estimates because of weak prices for polyester and titanium dioxide.
